name: American EcoFuels Inc.
summary: American EcoFuels Inc. engages in commercialization of gas-to-liquids, coal-to-liquids, and other synthetic fuel technologies in the United States. The company offers products and services related to converting natural gas and other feedstocks into Sustainable Aviation Fuel and related low-carbon fuel products. The company was formerly known as Eco Innovation Group, Inc. and changed its name to American EcoFuels Inc. in June 2026. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Southlake, Texas.
